text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains in a greed-dominated environment, with ETH slightly outpacing BTC, suggesting moderate confidence across the major assets. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady at 59.6% indicates the market isn't rotating heavily into alts despite solid performance from secondary chains like SOL and BNB. The $72B in daily volume paired with a Fear & Greed reading of 59 shows cautious optimism without euphoria, though the 10-point decline over a week signals sentiment may be cooling from earlier peaks.
